posts.title: Weeknotes #403 — Symposium IV
posts.description: Most of this week was spent in Barcelona, attending the Gartner IT Symposium/Xpo, a gigantic gathering of technology leaders from across Europe and beyond. It was the fourth time in a row that I’ve been there1, so I’m now something of a veteran. 📚 Finished reading To Hell With Poverty! A Class Act: Inside the Gang of Four by Jon King. I only discovered Gang of Four relatively recently, going to both of their shows in London in the past few years and loving every minute. I’m sorry I didn’t discover them sooner. 📚 Finished reading Act Like a Leader, Think Like a Leader by Herminia Ibarra. An excellent book, whose main premise is that you need to start doing and learning from experience instead of spending time thinking about the leader that you want to become.
